# 3A Technology Solutions & 3A Techvolution Academy

> 3A Technology Solutions provides practical digital solutions, custom software engineering, AI automation, data science, technology consulting, and academic research/project support. 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY is our AI-focused educational academy teaching AI fluency, prompt engineering, vibe coding, and practical AI applications.

## 3A Technology Solutions — Commercial Services
- [Commercial Services Overview](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services): Overview of our six core technology, consulting, and academic research support services.
- [Web & Digital Product Development](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/web-development): Corporate websites, school and institutional websites, landing pages, customer portals, web applications, and digital platforms.
- [Custom Software Engineering](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/custom-software): Custom business applications, administrative systems, school management portals, payment/result management systems, digital record management, and APIs.
- [Artificial Intelligence & Automation](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/ai-automation): AI integration into business processes, AI-powered applications, knowledge assistants, business workflow automation, document extraction, and AI readiness assessments.
- [Data Science & Analytics](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/data-science-analytics): Data extraction, cleaning, visualization, statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modelling, computer vision, and data-driven research support.
- [Technology Consulting](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/technology-consulting): Digital transformation planning, systems architecture review, technology stack advisory, process auditing, and technical feasibility roadmaps.
- [Academic Research & Project Support](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/academic-research-support): Ethical research consultation, technical mentorship, Python/ML/computational modelling implementation, and technical report/defence preparation for computing and mathematics projects.

## 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY — AI Education
- [Academy Overview](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy): AI-focused educational academy helping individuals, students, graduates, professionals, and organizations become fluent, productive users of AI.
- [AI Course Catalogue](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/programmes): Functional course catalogue covering AI Fluency & Prompt Engineering, Vibe Coding & AI-Assisted Software Development, AI Automation & Business Workflows, and Applied Machine Learning.
- [AI Seminars & Workshops](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/events): Upcoming AI awareness seminars, fluency webinars, practical workshops, and corporate AI training events.
- [Vibe Coding & AI-Assisted Development](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/vibe-coding): Learn how to build, understand, debug, and prototype real software responsibly using AI coding tools and agents.
- [Academy Resource Library](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/resources): Categorized library of free downloadable PDF guides, prompt checklists, templates, and paid AI workbooks/toolkits.
